# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight young man. He has a round face that is completely devoid of expression.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)_

## Personality

Barney possesses very little capacity for chatter or laughter and suffers from an agonizing inability to hold a conversation. He smirks and laughs softly, often unable to devise a verbal response until after the moment has already passed. Despite his quiet demeanor, he holds a vast admiration for Nell and feels immense pride when traveling in her company.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v1 c33 P30](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0030)_

## Traits

- Emotionless  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>
- Taciturn  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>

## History

Barney arrived in a carriage to transport Nell, Isolde, and Odette to a concert event in Pale Sands. Upon arrival, he demanded that Nell sit beside him on the front seat, insisting on her company despite her personal preference to sit in the back with the other girls. During the drive to the Pale Sands Hotel, he smirked and laughed softly in response to Nell's attempts at polite conversation, feeling immensely proud to accompany her while waiting outside with the team.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v1 c33 P30](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0030)_

## Relationships

### Nell Harcourt

- Romantic with — Vastly admires Nell and insists on driving her on the front seat of his carriage.  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>

### Odette Pullen

- Sibling of — Brother of Odette Pullen.  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>
